components.name: Code

runtimeRules.rule: inline=true rejects copy=true, highlight=true or showLanguage=true; omitted options remain valid inline.

limitations: Copy requires trusted user activation in a secure browser context; denied/unavailable Clipboard API reports a manual-copy fallback.
Only bundled grammars are supported; highlighting is not syntax validation.
components.docs: Code(data) is a foundation component in base/code. value is required (at most 12000 Unicode code points). Optional language selects a bundled highlight.js grammar; missing/unknown languages stay plain text. No auto-detection or execution. Block defaults: highlight=true, copy=true, showLanguage=true. The fallback label is Plain text. Set each option false to opt out. inline=true stays text-only and rejects true for copy, highlight or showLanguage. CodeView(data) is a compatible alias.

examples.description: Minimal code example using supplied data.

components.name: Slider

runtimeRules.rule: min < max; min <= value <= max; 0 < step <= max-min. If step is omitted the runtime uses 1.

components.name: Icon
limitations: No remote SVG or arbitrary path data.
components.docs: Only exact bundled canonical names are accepted. Arguments: name, label, tone, size. Use null label for a decorative icon beside visible text. Use a nonempty label for an icon that conveys meaning alone. Tones: default, muted, info, success, warning, error. Sizes: 16, 20, 24, 32, 48; default 20. Tone communicates supplied meaning; it never verifies status. Public OpenAI Apps SDK UI glyphs are distinct from Inform UI role mapping.

components.docs: Use ChecklistView(data). data is a strict supplied record; child slots accept actual DSL elements. Actions are runtime-issued local handles. Host-looking identifiers in data grant no execution permission.
